title: Check yourself: the cost of sealing

blocks.text: Questions on what this page has just taught. Choose one answer for each.

questions.stem: Which of these is among the drawbacks of sealed classes that this page lists?

options.text: Permitted subclasses must sit in other packages
options.says: The page says the opposite: permitted subclasses must be in the same module or package as the sealed type.

options.text: Permitted subclasses may no longer be records
options.says: The page recommends combining sealed types with records, and its own algebraic-data-type example does exactly that.

options.text: Extending the hierarchy later becomes harder
options.says: The page's first drawback is reduced flexibility: a sealed hierarchy is harder to extend when new subtypes are needed.

concepts: Sealing trades future extensibility for control, so a hierarchy that must grow later is harder to change.
